content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] ALERT: Dedicated pool 'horizonflux-enterprise-pool' GPU util=98% (sustained 5m). Tenant: HorizonFlux (single-tenant). Queueing increasing, p99 latency spiking. Auto-burst disabled for this tenant. Incident created.

raj_oncall: I'm on it. Paging infra and ops. Will assess impact and propose mitigation.

pagerduty: Paging: raj_oncall, sara_sre, mike_ops

sara_sre: joining in ~3m. pulling dashboards -> https://dash.redwood/ops/horizonflux-enterprise (watching enqueue, gpu-saturation, kv-cache)

mike_ops: seeing rapid enqueue, MIG partitions hitting max on node-group a-1. No preemptible capacity in this region.

lina_se: FYI HorizonFlux is enterprise-tier with SLA. Account PM looped.

accounts_pm: pinged customer contacts. will notify once we have mitigation path.

raj_oncall: Proposed plan: (1) enable manual burst override for tenant for 30m (2) scale pool +2 GPUs (3) route heavy/batch requests to smaller model variant (hf-compact) as fallback. Suggest feature-flagged rollout for routing. Approve?

sara_sre: +1. Add quick canary (10%) to validate fallback does not introduce errors. Watch kv-cache warming.

mike_ops: I can run the override now. Commands I will run:
```
rctl dedicated-burst enable --tenant=HorizonFlux --duration=00:30:00 --reason="queueing spike"
rctl pool scale --pool=horizonflux-enterprise-pool --add-gpus=2 --type=gaudi-v2
```

raj_oncall: Go for it. @lina_se please authorize burst.

lina_se: Authorizing manual burst override. Accounts PM to confirm billing consent post-fact. Proceed.

mike_ops: running commands... done. Pool scale request queued (req-8732). Burst mode ON for HorizonFlux.

incident-bot: ACTION: burst-override enabled by mike_ops. Pool scale request req-8732 submitted. Monitor: https://ops.redwood/requests/req-8732

sara_sre: Applying routing canary: hf-compact -> 5% traffic to start. Config snippet: 
```
routes:
  - id: horizonflux-fallback
    percent: 5
    model: hf-compact-v1
```
Applying...

sara_sre: routing change applied. watching latencies and model error-rate.

mike_ops: metrics update: enqueue length dropping, GPU util down to 82% in 4m. good signal.

raj_oncall: continue monitoring. if util > 90% after 10m, escalate to regional burst and prepare eviction of low-priority tenants on affected nodes.

accounts_pm: reached out to customer with message: "We're applying a temporary burst and fallback routing; you may see degraded throughput for heavy jobs for ~30 minutes. We'll update as we make progress."

lina_se: prepare eviction plan for non-critical tenants on same nodes if req-8732 insufficient. notify SRE runbook owners.

mike_ops: pool scale completed, +2 GPUs online. util now ~70%. KV cache stable.

sara_sre: no errors seen in generation logs. latency recovering, p99 trending down.

raj_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. keeping thread open for post-incident tasks: root cause, billing, alert tuning. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated_by_burst, closed_by=raj_oncall, closed_at=3245679018

accounts_pm: customer acknowledged and appreciated the rapid response.

lina_se: Postmortem owners: sara_sre, mike_ops. Action items: enable opt-in auto-burst for enterprise tenants, include "burst disabled" flag in alerts, improve regional preemptible capacity visibility.

sara_sre: will draft the postmortem with timeline, commands, dashboards, and follow-ups.

mike_ops: adding command logs and request ids to incident doc.

raj_oncall: thanks all, nice work. we'll sync tomorrow for RCA and follow-ups.
